root_cause.text: adis_init() dereferences adis->ops without first checking if it is NULL, leading to a NULL pointer dereference when drivers that do not set custom ops rely on the defaults and adis->ops is zero-initialized to NULL.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes the condition from `if (!adis->ops->write && !adis->ops->read && !adis->ops->reset)` to `if (!adis->ops)`, directly addressing the missing NULL check. The CVE description confirms that drivers like adis16480 do not set custom ops and adis->ops is NULL because struct adis is zero-initialized by devm_iio_device_alloc().
